messages:
andrew-cs: heads up — MX customer reporting promo failure when applying FREE30. error from API: promo_not_applicable_tax_rule. they say it used to work last week. can we investigate? :thinking:

maria-support: case #12345 opened by customer (acct_acctMX9). repro steps i followed: set currency=MXN, subtotal=295.00, tax=47.20, attempt apply promo FREE30 => response error. customer says invoice displays subtotal 300 due to a tax withholding adjustment they see. attaching payload below.

maria-support: request payload:
```json
{
  "account_id": "acct_acctMX9",
  "promo_code": "FREE30",
  "currency": "MXN",
  "items": [{"desc":"api usage", "amount":295.00}],
  "tax": {"rate": 0.16, "tax_withholding": -32.00} 
}
```

maria-support: server response:
```json
{
  "error": "promo_not_applicable_tax_rule",
  "message": "Promo eligibility failed due to tax/locale rules",
  "promo_id": "promo_987"
}
```

kevin-eng: can you paste the raw billing record link and the exact timestamps? i'll run a local repro. my guess: we have a rounding/withholding edge — our promo eligibility check probably includes tax_withholding in the subtotal calculation which it shouldn't.

maria-support: billing link: https://app.redwood.com/billing/acct_acctMX9/invoices/2026-03-12-01 . happened at 2026-03-12T14:22Z. customer screenshot: "subtotal 300.00, tax 48.00, withholding -32.00, total 316.00" they claim subtotal meets promo min (300) but our API check used a different intermediate value.

juan-billing: quick finance note: Mexico specifics — some customers configure tax_withholding for domestic ISR/withholding; that shows as a negative tax line on invoice. Our policy: promos evaluate against pre-tax subtotal (not including tax or withholding). if withholding is applied on the invoice it must not affect eligibility.

kevin-eng: confirmed locally. bug: eligibility_calc = round(subtotal + tax_withholding, 2) in legacy codepath. so negative withholding reduces the base used for promo_min check. reproduction script snippet:
```py
subtotal = Decimal('300.00')
tax = Decimal('48.00')
withholding = Decimal('-32.00')
# buggy check
elig_base = (subtotal + withholding).quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
# => 268.00 which fails promo_min 300
```

lara-legal: heads-up: for some regulated customers we cannot auto-credit taxes via promos. but this is eligibility evaluation only — the legal constraint is that promo cannot be applied to a tax line itself, not to whether a customer qualifies based on pre-tax subtotal. so code fix aligns with policy.

kevin-eng: plan: 1) patch eligibility to use pre-tax subtotal only (ignore tax_withholding) and ensure rounding happens after eligibility decision 2) add unit + e2e test for MXN withholding case 3) prepare hotfix PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5678 (draft)

andrew-cs: ETA on hotfix and prod deploy? customer is on trial and blocked from claiming free trial credits.

kevin-eng: hotfix -> staging in ~2h for QA, prod deploy in next maintenance window (~4h) if QA passes. will add feature flag for rollback. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created by kevin-eng. link: https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-345

maria-support: i'll keep customer updated. also granted temporary manual credit so they can continue while we patch: grant_id grant_890, amount MXN 350, expires in 7 days. logged note in case.

juan-billing: finance note: reconcile grant_890 under GL code PROMO_MISC-2026. i flagged on the invoice.

andrew-cs: thanks all — please post PR link and deploy confirmation here once done.

kevin-eng: will do. adding automated test vectors for MXN withholding and CHF rounding after patch.
